subject: Discovery recap + quick check on priority for next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@datasuite.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@datasuite.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + quick check on priority for next steps

Hi Olivia / Mark —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the same page: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency on customer-facing search features and cut per-token cost for nightly batch enrichment.
- Current infra: mixed on-prem GPUs and cloud endpoints, tight procurement window for Q4 budget.
- Success metric: 20–30% lower median latency at 99th pct and ~30% cost reduction on inference spend.

What Redwood would bring (high level):
- Dedicated pooled capacity for predictable throughput + smart routing to keep latency stable
- Prefix/KV caching patterns to lower per-token cost for your enrichment jobs
- Private deployment options for regulated datasets if needed

Proposed next steps: 
1) If the above aligns, schedule a 30-min technical review with your infra lead to go over the integration checklist (I can bring our solutions engineer).
2) I’ll prepare a short cost/latency sketch using your estimated qps (need a rough qps number and typical sequence length).

Attachments: discovery slides (datasuite-discovery-slides.pdf), call recording stub (call-recording-20260823.mp3).

Ask: could you confirm whether this is a priority for the Q4 procurement window? If timing is flexible, we can slow the cadence — if it’s a high priority we’ll align right away.

Thanks —
Soojin
